run_gen_tasks: run the gen_tasks function to generate 1000 labeled sentiment analysis tasks with 5 annotations each and write to tasks_and_annotations.json
test_gen_tasks: test the gen_tasks function with a custom user_id to produce a bulk-importable tasks_and_annotations JSON file
summarize_gen_tasks: summarize the gen_tasks function that generates random sentiment annotation tasks for bulk import into Label Studio
